Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

english.notes:
(i) This offence applies from the 28th June 2022 due to changes made by paragraph 15 of Schedule 7 to the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022 which extended the remit of the offence to also cover expedited public spaces protection orders. For the offence applying before this date, see H11456.
(iv) This offence is eligible for a Fixed Penalty Notice (under section 68 of the Act). Such a notice may be issued by a constable (and a suitably designated PCSO) as well as the local authority.
(v) A fixed penalty issued for this offence is payable to the local authority and should not be processed using the PentiP system.
